title: LS_34231_HK_Landing.MP3 by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Landing at Hong Kong. (binaural, please use headset for 3D effect) I recorded this binaural audio file in an airplane going from Manila to Hong Kong. The flight was quite late and you can hear some Chinese and Filipino passengers talking, some kids talking and playing (they were little excited because of the delay), while everyone was waiting the time to land. Then, the airplane takes off, and the hostess announces that we arrived and thanks the passengers to fly with Cebu Pacific... Recorded in February 2019 with an Olympus LS-3 and Soundman OKM I binaural microphones (version 2018). Fade in/
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -23.20 dBFS); 30 ms fades
